scope: Additional offline adaptive-plan integration, not a replacement for fixed-world72-scenarios.v1.json or real-model judgment.

phases.fact: Three repeated attempts face a closed destination after one successful INSPECT.
Each owner may abandon the blocked method, retain its long goal and execute a new local method.
A co-present witnessed statement enters owner context before the next method revision.
An explicit authoritative fixture wallet update to zero is persisted before owner resource-aware revision.
Owners choose actual Core travel to station followed by peer TALK; subsequent context must reflect actual locations and relationships.
Owners reconsider with actual new location and sourced relationship facts, preserving their long goals.
A final owner review occurs after restart, with the same goal and no replay of earlier successful prefixes.

mechanics.trade: Finite stock and wallet: actual daily player BUY once; exactly three paid units, no free NPC products.
mechanics.relations: Commerce disabled and authored contact relationship policy; actual cyclic NPC TALK settles relationships.
mechanics.calendar: Commerce disabled, authored calendar and future not_before on replacement methods; no execution before the scheduled time.

checks: Every paid three-hour interval advances the authoritative clock by exactly180 minutes; NPC work cannot charge world time twice.
Every prior receipt remains byte-equivalent and unique, old INSPECT prefix occurs once per NPC, abandoned method cursors do not regress.
All three owners retain the exact same active long goal; every replacement has an owned goal and actual committed completion receipts.
At twelve-hour boundaries, exact canonical request replay must not rerun its mutator, generate, write current.json or change response/bytes.
At12/36/60 hours recreate JsonStore/AIRuntime/GameService, compare full saved authority and replay the preceding request before continuing.
Final states require six completed replacement methods per NPC and one abandoned original; pending travel/TALK may not be falsely completed.
No private peer/world facts enter public view; controlled candidates do not establish real-model adaptive judgment or human narrative quality.
